propositions: Core modules (fetcher, applier, apply_handlers, _attestation) currently import adapters.jira directly for scalar concerns and must eliminate all such imports via backend protocol extension

Backend protocol must expose read-only scalar accessors (project, query_project) and assert_env_ready() method that raise neutral BackendEnvError for environment validation, replacing vendor-specific fail-fast logic
JiraBackend implementation delegates new scalar members to resolve_jira_settings() with appropriate defaults (DIG for applier guard, un-defaulted for fetcher JQL scoping)
BackendAssigneeNotFoundError neutral exception hierarchy replaces vendor-specific AssigneeNotFoundError, preserving soft-fail assignee handling in apply_handlers
Full-tree AST walk (ast.walk, not top-level only) must verify four modules contain zero adapters.jira imports at any nesting depth including lazy/function-local imports
ADR 0035 §(d) interface table documents new scalar members and neutral exceptions as canonical port requirements for future backend implementors
